peptide_bioactivity.verification: Full text (J-STAGE, free): peptic digest of short-necked clam Tapes philippinarum (= R. philippinarum); peptides synthesized by solid phase (Applied Biosystems 430A); HHL (Peptide Institute), rabbit-lung ACE (Sigma), modified Cheung & Cushman; Table 1 and text give IC50 in uM. The text's peak-by-peak IC50 list swaps clam and pearl oyster relative to the sequence sentence and Table 1; IAE belongs to the clam under both readings, so it is kept.
